Container.Name: Words
Container.Overview: Words is a self-hosted real-time letter-grid party game. Open the WebUI on a shared display, then have players join from their phones using the room link or QR code. No accounts or persistent database are required.
Container.Requires: Player devices must be able to reach the Words WebUI. Rooms and game state are intentionally temporary and are lost when the container restarts.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP and WebSocket port for Words.
